_meta.notes: Captured from `cargo bench -p lora-database --bench memory -- --quick` on Apple Silicon. Numbers are bytes from `MemoryReport::total_bytes()` after the build phase (or after_query for chain/star/social which run a representative MATCH after building). Tolerance is per-scenario; a regression beyond `total * (1 + tolerance_pct/100)` fails the gate. Bump the baseline whenever an intentional storage-shape change shifts a scenario. 2026-09-29: property maps became key-sorted vectors, index postings inline single ids, adjacency lists inline two edges. These are MemoryReport estimates; `cargo run --release -p lora-database --example heap_probe` measures real allocations. Later the same day: slabs, adjacency and label indexes became chunked copy-on-write vectors and index maps copy-on-write shards (structural sharing for staged writes). 2026-10-06: labels and relationship types are interned (no per-record strings) and adjacency entries carry the type and neighbour inline. Later the same day: records are stored as encoded bytes with dictionary-numbered labels, types and keys.
